name: Bánokszentgyörgy (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bánokszentgyörgy: a blue and green shield with a white horseman, a wavy stripe and ears of grain, above a scroll inscribed BÁNOKSZENTGYÖRGY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
